recap: Day 12, and Savu rolls into Tribal Council three strong — which, let's be honest, is about as cozy and as brutal as this game gets. It started at the immunity challenge, where Toka and Dina grabbed the necklaces and Ori, Jelly and Devin simply could not crack the puzzle. Back at camp, Ori worked every angle, trying to get Jelly and Devin pointing at each other. Devin floated everybody playing a Shot in the Dark and letting fate decide. Then Jelly pulled out an immunity idol, and just like that the math got very small and very personal. At Tribal, Ori reached for his Shot in the Dark, unfurled the scroll — NOT SAFE. Jelly and Devin, sadly and reluctantly, wrote down the name of a Day 1 ally. The helicopter alliance turned on itself, and Ori Jean-Charles became the seventh person voted out of Survivor 51.
bullets: Jelly's idol reveal turned a three-person Tribal into a two-person decision before anyone even sat down.
Ori's Shot in the Dark came up NOT SAFE — the worst three words in the game.
On the summit, Ori and Sharonda brought back ribs and corn while Kristin took Exile and a tethered idol she can only play on them — and with Ori gone, that thing just got more powerful.
Loverboys in crisis: Eric called Kilby's Linnea move "the biggest betrayal I have ever felt" and labeled him "the most dangerous player in this game."
Brady's baby penguin impression of Maggie is the rivalry this season didn't know it needed, while Mike sits on the outs at Toka with nobody buying what he's selling.
draftImpact: Tim, you are the story of the night — 28 to 44, a +16, and all four of your castaways still breathing. Tami, you're right behind at 36 after a +12, three of five still in. Austin and Kylie each picked up +8, landing at 32 and 27. And Taylor, I'm sorry — Ori goes home, you're at 30 with two of four left. Tim leads, Tami's chasing. The board is wide open.
